notes: This contract pins Umbra's bounded IEEE 1516.1-2025 Time Advance Request Available service to source-derived clause 8.9. The embedded profile retains the supplied request until the existing callback-gated Time Advance Grant path, records the accepted request with its Table 5 LogicalTime representation before that grant, delivers currently queued TSO input through the path, and uses the inclusive defined-GALT boundary required by the Available form. Default-source and explicit-source regional interaction companions now carry their respective region contexts through the same inclusive TARA boundary, verifying the supplied-empty marker for the private default source and the preserved RegionHandle for an explicit source; both remain in-process HLA_EVOKED cases. A default-source timestamped attribute-update companion exercises one ordinary/default-region passel through the same inclusive TARA boundary as part of a shared FQR/TARA/NMRA frontier and proves callback-before-grant ordering. A mixed-member regional companion exercises TARA alongside FQR and NMRA recipients in the same in-process frontier, proving the TSO callback precedes the TARA grant. A separate restore-control matrix snapshots one no-queued-TSO, single-federate TARA request at direct save initiation and restores its fresh grant after Federation Restored under both callback models. Future transport input, complete GALT/LITS coordination, Flush Queue Grant, multi-member or queued/in-transit restore, package/catalog evidence, protected review, and conformance remain outside this slice.
